title: 第10章 杵着当障碍物？上来
slug: 酒店亲错人京圈大佬他白天嫌弃晚上疯
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

傅临渊摇头。

傅崇山：“裴家的姑娘裴听雪，下周回国，你们见见。”

傅临渊：“爷爷是想联姻？”

傅崇山：“裴家在高层的关系，能让你少奋斗十年。爷爷为你好。”

傅临渊落子，吃掉了一片黑子：“我不需要。”

傅崇山：“凡事要看长远，现在不需要不等于以后不需要。”

傅临渊：“不用您操心。”

傅崇山依旧耐心：“那姑娘我打听了，各方面条件都不错，人也漂亮，跟你挺般配。”

“我下周出差没空。”傅临渊起身离开书房。

“那等你回来再见也行。”傅崇山在他身后喊。

傅临渊没回话。

走出书房，他迎面撞上傅正霆，身后还跟着苏曼丽和傅临霄。

傅正霆转头跟后面两人说了一声，让傅临渊跟他在正厅坐下。

傅正霆先开口：“你最近怎么样？”

傅临渊笑：“没话找话？”

傅正霆拧眉：“我是关心你，毕竟是一家人。”

傅临渊嘴角扯了一下：“我妈咽气，你在苏曼丽床上。我姐跟我被绑，你拖了六个小时才报警，一家人？”

他起身："你的家人，只有苏曼丽和傅临霄。"

傅正霆脸色骤变，吼出声：“逆子，我是你爸！”

傅临渊不理他，起身走向房间。

傅崇山听到动静从书房出来，劝傅正霆：“行了，别吵了，他好不容易才回来一次，一见面就吵。”

傅正霆叹气：“您也听到了，是他卯着劲儿跟我吵。”

傅崇山：“他心里有死结，不是那么容易想开的，你还是多包容他一点。”

傅正霆：“就怕他一直想不开！”

傅临渊穿过长廊，脚步在尽头那扇胡桃木门前停住。

推门而入。

屋子里被打扫得很干净，摆设还是与当年一模一样。

墙边摆着一架钢琴，琴凳还是那把旧的，他坐下来，试着按下第一个键。

音不准。这架琴太久没调了。

可就在那一个音落下去的瞬间，他忽然听见了那道温柔声音。

Page (1/3)

Fu Linyuan shook his head.

Fu Chongshan: "Pei Tingxue, the girl from the Pei family, will return to China next week. You can meet her."

Fu Linyuan: "Grandpa, do you want to get married?"

Fu Chongshan: "The Pei family's high-level relationships can save you ten years of hard work. Grandpa does it for your own good."

Fu Linyuan made a move and ate a piece of sunspot: "I don't need it."

Fu Chongshan: "You have to take a long-term view of everything. If you don't need it now, it doesn't mean you won't need it in the future."

Fu Linyuan: "You don't need to worry."

Fu Chongshan remained patient: "I asked about that girl. She has good conditions in all aspects and is pretty. She is a good match for you."

"I'm not available for a business trip next week." Fu Linyuan stood up and left the study.

"Then I'll see you again when you come back." Fu Chongshan called after him.

Fu Linyuan didn't reply.

When he walked out of the study, he bumped into Fu Zhengting, followed by Su Manli and Fu Linxiao.

Fu Zhengting turned around and spoke to the two people behind him, asking Fu Linyuan to sit down with him in the main hall.

Fu Zhengting spoke first: "How are you doing lately?"

Fu Linyuan smiled: "You have nothing to say?"

Fu Zhengting frowned: "I care about you. After all, we are a family."

Fu Linyuan twitched the corner of his mouth: "My mother died, and you were on Su Manli's bed. My sister and I were kidnapped, and it took you six hours to call the police. Are you a family?"

He stood up and said, "Your family members are only Su Manli and Fu Linxiao."

Fu Zhengting's expression suddenly changed, and he shouted: "Young man, I am your father!"

Fu Linyuan ignored him, stood up and walked to the room.

Fu Chongshan came out of the study when he heard the commotion and advised Fu Zhengting: "Okay, stop arguing. He only came back once after a long time, and he makes noise as soon as we meet."

Fu Zhengting sighed: "You heard it too, he was the one who tried his best to argue with me."

Fu Chongshan: "He has a stubborn knot in his heart, which is not easy to get rid of. You should be more tolerant of him."

Fu Zhengting: "I'm afraid he won't be able to think about it!"

Fu Linyuan walked through the corridor and stopped in front of the walnut door at the end.

Push the door open and enter.

The house was cleaned very clean and the furnishings were exactly the same as before.

There was a piano by the wall, and the piano bench was still the same. He sat down and tried to press the first key.

The tone is not accurate.This piano hasn't been tuned for a long time.

But at the moment when the sound fell, he suddenly heard that gentle voice.
